## anti-slop

This release adds `anti-slop`, a deterministic Markdown and MDX prose linter for pre-commit.

### Highlights

- 25 explainable rules for filler, canned phrases, rhetorical repetition, rhythm, and formatting density
- Markdown-aware source projection with exact line and column diagnostics
- recommended and strict presets
- JSON configuration and local suppression comments
- text, JSON, and GitHub annotation output
- no third-party runtime dependencies
- 24 unit and CLI tests

The included coffee calibration starts with a deliberately bloated article that produces 44 diagnostics across 17 rule families. The revised article produces zero. The tuning pass also removed false positives from sectioned API reference prose without weakening the target cases.

See `docs/anti-slop.md` for configuration and the full rule catalog.
